thread:
mia: Quick sync — want to run a 60m webinar in ~6 weeks on 'Serving LLMs with predictable economics'. Two possible angles: (A) Benchmark narrative + migration checklist, (B) Platform ops & rollout (canary/rollback). I lean A for top-funnel. Thoughts?

owen: I vote A. Focus on measurable outcomes — cost per 1M tokens, latency SLOs, and a short before/after case study. Keep slides metric-forward.

sarah: +1 for A. Proposed speakers: Owen for benchmarks, Elena for customer story, Marco for a short demo. @elena are you able to do the customer piece?

elena: :raising_hand: I can — will need to anonymize details. Also prefer a 3-slide story arc (problem, approach, outcome).

marco: I can do the demo: show routing -> fallback to quantized model. Need a stripped dataset and a staging endpoint with token limits. @devex-bot can you provision a sandbox?

devex-bot: Provision request accepted. ETA 48h. Project: marketing-webinar-1799. Logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/1799

mia: Draft run-of-show (60m):
```
00:00-00:05 Intro + house rules
00:05-00:20 Benchmarks & narrative (Owen)
00:20-00:35 Customer story + ops (Elena)
00:35-00:45 Live demo (Marco)
00:45-00:55 Q&A (panel)
00:55-01:00 CTAs + closing (Mia)
```

owen: Suggestion: swap demo earlier to keep momentum — intro, demo, benchmarks, customer, Q&A, CTA. Demo moves energy up front.

sarah: Good call. Also we need registration form fields to route inbound leads by infra interest (hosted / dedicated / private) and MQL scoring. I'll draft routing rules and loop in Lindsay from SDRs.

mia: Action items: Owen — benchmark slides + 2 headline graphs; Marco — demo script + staging URL; Elena — 3-slide customer writeup; Sarah — registration + routing fields. I'll schedule two rehearsals: tech run (3 days prior) and full dress (1 day prior).

elena: Can you share the slide template? I'll keep story concise.

mia: Template in marketing drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/mkt/webinar-templates. Proposed rehearsals: Tue 1pm PT (tech) and Thu 4pm PT (dress). Anyone blocked?

owen: Both times work for me.

marco: I'll be on PTO Tue morning; 1pm PT tech run is fine.

sarah: Works.

mia: Updated invites going out now. Thanks all :pray: We'll track assets in the marketing folder and I added a checklist in the doc.
